verdict.rationale: Docs list API reference endpoints (fiat transfers, orchestrations, etc.) but nothing describes an interactive 'try it' console or runnable code examples, and probes for standard OpenAPI/Swagger specs (which typically power such interactivity) all returned 404s. Missing for 10: any mention of a try-it/run-in-browser feature, discoverable OpenAPI spec, or interactive sandbox tied to the reference docs.
